defensiveAbilities.name: Fan Club
defensiveAbilities.description: A dredgelit maintains a bond with up to six other willing creatures. Creatures in the fan club always know the general distance and direction toward other bonded creatures, any conditions affecting them, and if they're Unconscious, Dying, or dead. Creatures in the fan club can always communicate telepathically while on the same plane of existence.

defensiveAbilities.name: Phantasmal Fans
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. A rowdy spectral crowd always surrounds the dredgelit. The dredgelit has concealment against all creatures, and the crowd counts as difficult terrain.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Alluring Debut
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once every 10 minutes

Effect The dredgelit attempts a Performance check against the Will DC of a single creature within 30 feet, recreating an iconic show.

Critical Success The creature becomes part of their fan club for 24 hours, even if it's unwilling.

Success As critical success, but only for 1 hour.

Failure The creature is unaffected.

Critical Failure The creature is unaffected, and the dredgelit is so embarrassed by their failure to perform that they take 2d8 Mental Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Parasocial Leech
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The dredgelit leeches vitality from a creature in their fan club. The dredgelit attempts a Performance check against the Will DC of the creature. The creature takes 6d6 Void Damage damage, and the dredgelit regains 10 Healing Damage Hit Points.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and is Stunned 2 and Immobilized for 1 round.

Success The target takes full damage and is Stunned 1 and immobilized for 1 round.

Failure The target is unaffected.

Critical Failure The target is unaffected. The dredgelit's abysmal performance results in them taking 2d8 Mental Damage damage instead of regaining Hit Points.
